scope: Numerical regularization of the IMPACT-I02G 2024-T3 M(T) cohesive seam by local crack-tip refinement. This is not a Boeing 767 or WTC facade model.

geometry.loading: fixed lower grip and prescribed upper-grip displacement
geometry.source: NASA CR-191523 Figure 1 and specimen description

material_baseline_applied.name: AA2024-T3
material_baseline_applied.reason: Preserved unchanged from I02G so that I02H isolates spatial and temporal discretization effects. It is a bounded baseline, not the newly identified measured curve.

identified_material_curve_not_applied.model_in_source: piecewise-linear uniaxial input to the STAGS White-Besseling plasticity model
identified_material_curve_not_applied.status: identified primary-source curve; translated separately for fresh-state LAW36 sensitivity and never used to alter an already damaged state

material_tabulated_radioss.name: AA2024-T3 NASA L-T translated for fresh-state LAW36 sensitivity
material_tabulated_radioss.last_point_status: explicit constant-stress numerical continuation beyond the final 0.16 engineering-strain source point; no failure strain is assigned
material_tabulated_radioss.history_rule: fresh undeformed case only; never substituted into an already damaged state

mesh.construction: symmetric tensor-product mesh; local_step in x from -outer_x_break to +outer_x_break and in y within near_seam_half_height; coarse far field outside
mesh.cohesive_node_tributary_rule: Voronoi width clipped to the two intact ligament intervals
mesh.qualification: local refinement only; no remeshing, XFEM, shell deletion or 3D crack tunneling

seam.formulation: massless zero-length TYPE8 springs along the prescribed horizontal crack path
seam.qualification: I02G numerical baseline; Gf remains hypothetical and is not fitted to the NASA stress or CTOA comparators

sources.use: M(T) geometry and independent stable-tearing stress and CTOA comparators
